_note: Ready-made 1.6_live docker stack on the Internet Archive (the vendor's all-in-one server package). The agent downloads it next to GIO_DIR_16 (<dir>.7z, resumable), verifies size + md5 (the values of the archive.org item's <item>_files.xml), extracts it into a sibling temp folder with 7zz/7z/7za/7zr/bsdtar (Linux) or 7-Zip/tar.exe (Windows), renames the top folder onto GIO_DIR_16, repairs the exec bits and deletes the archive. A verified <dir>.7z put there by hand (scp) is adopted without a download. extractedSize = bytes of the unpacked tree (disk check).
label: Internet Archive
